title: Distributed, Sync, Resource, Deployment, and Evolution Language Contracts
acceptance_criteria: Every promoted distributed/offline/resource/cloud/media/realtime/evolution fact is compiler-validated and Canonical-IR materialized or explicitly rejected.
The language can express M12-M15 contracts without runtime milestones redefining syntax or semantics.
Runtime/provider conformance remains separate from language/compiler completion.
Compatibility classification retains one semantic authority.
